links.fail_closed: Missing, duplicate, malformed or changed member/parent

links.identity_source: Explicit r11 pointer and frozen resolver
links.sha256_check: Pointer SHA is r11 member; resolver checks every member and aggregate
links.uniqueness: Exactly one explicitly selected revision; no latest-file discovery
links.fail_closed: Pointer mismatch, stale r10 fallback or import-time cache

links.sha256_check: Must pin exact r11 revision/path/raw SHA and frozen evaluation/validator hashes
links.uniqueness: New authorization, attempt and derived namespace IDs; no old ID reuse
links.lifecycle: Issued unconsumed only; separate old r10 non-reuse/retirement proof
links.fail_closed: r10 binding, prior attempt, inconsistent reducer or ambiguous active set

links.identity_source: New versioned r11 producer in freeze member inventory
links.sha256_check: Self-check against current r11 member SHA before claim; later frozen consumer recomputes same SHA
links.uniqueness: Generates fresh ID matching formal consumer grammar
links.lifecycle: Independent non-consuming invocation before formal execution
links.fail_closed: Code drift, bad authorization/freeze binding or incompatible ID/path

links.identity_source: Frozen producer/consumer schema and a new versioned genesis; runtime log itself is mutable
links.sha256_check: Genesis/schema validation plus append-only claimed-prefix length/SHA; never pin mutable full-file SHA as freeze member
links.uniqueness: Locked strict full-history parse; one exact ID/authorization/producer/target claim; no duplicates
links.lifecycle: Claim append+fsync before transport or artifact; failed invocation remains used
links.fail_closed: Absent, symlink, truncated, invalid UTF-8/JSON, duplicate, altered prefix or missing claim

links.identity_source: Exclusive write after a durable registry claim
links.sha256_check: Explicit artifact raw SHA passed to frozen consumer; artifact records r11 freeze/auth/producer SHA and registry prefix
links.uniqueness: Target absent before claim; no second artifact for same invocation ID
links.lifecycle: Non-consuming; timestamp after authorization; no attempt/namespace
links.fail_closed: Claim/artifact mismatch, target collision, missing readiness or changed bytes

links.sha256_check: Own member SHA; authorization/r11/raw artifact SHA; proposed producer member SHA and registry claim/prefix
links.lifecycle: All checks before adapter/transaction side effect
links.fail_closed: Any mismatch; no fallback to r10 or skipped registry check

links.path: Existing formal runner/adapter paths, future command NOT_CREATED
links.sha256_check: Recheck current r11 freeze, authorization, preflight and all supplied evaluation hashes
links.lifecycle: Only a separately authorized later step may execute
links.fail_closed: Old command, prior identity, collision or partial transaction
